notes: ANZ India is wholesale/institutional banking only. No retail deposit products in India.

gap_classification.notes: ANZ India (anz.com/institutional/global/india) is an institutional & corporate banking branch only — transaction banking, markets, trade & supply chain, term financing. No retail/consumer term-deposit product and no public FD rate card. ANZ's term-deposit rate pages on anz.com.au / anz.co.nz are for Australia/NZ, not the India branch.
